procedural_matters: Diego Yubero, support person of ESP 424, attended the hearing as observer.
Daniel Bramervaer, support person of NED 987, attended the hearing as observer.
ESP 424 provided photographic evidence during the hearing (a screenshot of Vakaros tracking system).
facts: Race 4, 49er yellow fleet, wind 20 kts with choppy sea.
NED 987 reached the zone of mark 1 on starboard tack clear ahead of ESP 424 by two to three boat lengths.
NED 987 rounded the mark less than a boat length ahead of ESP 424.
ESP 424, while leaving the mark, established an overlap to leeward of NED 987 with a lateral distance of one boat length.
After sailing for 5 boat lentghs, a contact occurred between the the forestay of ESP 424 and the boom of NED 987.
Immediately after the contact, ESP 424 began nosediving and her mast hit the mast, the main sail and the trapeze wires of NED 987.
The crew of NED 987 fell overboard.
Both boats capsized at the same time.
After rightening the boat ESP 424 regained control and took a one-turn penalty.
There was no damage nor injury.
conclusions: NED 987 to windward failed to keep clear of ESP 424 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
NED 987 did not avoid contact with ESP 424 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
ESP 424 did not avoid contact with NED 987 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
Since ESP 424 was right-of way boat and the contact did not cause damage or injury, she is exonerated under RRS 43.1(c) for breaking RRS 14.
decision: Protest upheld. NED 987 is DSQ in Race 4.
